profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer II @ Tempus AI 🧬 | skate.dev
profile.summary:
From high performance computing to running startups to full stack software engineering at scale, I am fascinated in all things tech and love finding the proper solution to a problem. I always end up as a thought leader wherever I work. The higher the impact and value that I can provide the more it piques my interest.

∴

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: From working on the Infectious Disease team to a horizontal team focused on config driven and generic code, I've worked on a lot of high impact and high visibility projects. With the aim of saving patient lives and making development easier for vertical teams. Have put myself in a position to be defining standards across my department and becoming an invaluable member as well.

positions.title: Advanced App Engineering Specialist
positions.description: Along with the previous responsibilities, mentored multiple new hires and ramped them up to be productive members of the team. Also, took a larger role in client communications and driving the trajectory of projects

positions.title: Advanced App Engineering Senior Analyst
positions.description: Developed multiple applications for Fortune 500 clients using cutting edge technology in a startup like environment. Working alongside stakeholders and interfacing with clients while also architecting and building out solutions for the real world.

positions.title: Head Of Engineering
positions.description: Continued the development work, while polishing features and making for a better user experience

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Prototyped Alluxo's web and mobile MVP in record time with requirements and designs in hand. Often brainstormed and became a part of the decision making on how to improve the product suite. Integrated with 3rd party APIs to streamline dashboards that auto-update as well as provide automated insights on your financials.

positions.title: VP of Engineering
positions.description: Lead development and mentored engineers on building a scalable multi-media mobile application and brand. Own the Spot reached 30,000 users organically and was the #1 skateboarding application on Android and iOS app stores. Pitched and won accelerator grants, hosted multiple events, sold merchandise, and make a mark on the Skateboarding industry.
positions.insights: Skills: PostgreSQL · GraphQL · Serverless Computing · Startup Environments · Mentoring · React Native

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer (Mobile)
positions.description: Single handedly built out and lead development on the React Native application that powered The Authentic Company's social media network. Managed multiple engineers and the mobile roadmap to align with stakeholders. Incorporated 3rd party integrations like Spotify, and Stripe.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · Expo · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React Native · Leading Development Teams

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: Built out and maintained Angular application and back end that connected students and tutors together based on location and courses
positions.insights: Skills: AngularJS · CoffeeScript · Web Development · MongoDB

positions.title: Co-Founder, Software Engineer
positions.description: React Native application that allows placing an order remotely at bars while connecting with POS systems. Designed, architected, and built out an MVP for presenting to investors.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · 3rd Party Software Integration · PostgreSQL · Expo · React Native
